kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: A judge permanently dismisses former Olympian's Reflecting Pool charges
wire.summary: Citing "exceptional circumstances," a D.C. judge has ruled that the federal government cannot refile its Reflecting Pool charges against David Hearn, despite pressure from President Trump to do so.

wire.title: AI data centers: How much are ratepayers on the hook for?
wire.summary: Data centers consume large amounts of power and require upgrading infrastructure. But it's difficult to determine how much residential customers benefit and how much they actually pay for the benefit.

wire.title: Cornell Jane Doe's attorney says she told police in 2024: 'I was raped'
wire.summary: Counter to what a local prosecutor has claimed, the alleged victim of a 2024 gang rape at Cornell University clearly said in her police statement that she was sexually assaulted, her attorney told NPR.

wire.title: New space station crew launches from Florida on SpaceX's Crew Dragon capsule
wire.summary: The crew of four — two NASA astronauts, one from Canada, and a Russian cosmonaut — heads to the International Space Station after liftoff from the Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida.

wire.title: What a Pearly King taught me about Cockney rhyming slang and East London history
wire.summary: In mother-of-pearl suits, the Pearly Kings used to canvass East London for charity. The most famous one, George Major, died in August. A look back on this larger-than-life figure and the Pearly King tradition.

wire.title: Passengers recount chaos on Tel Aviv flight. And, FBI probes employee-data hack
wire.summary: What we know so far about the tense moments aboard a Tel Aviv-bound flight. And, the FBI investigates a cyberattack involving sensitive employee data.

wire.title: Picanha, prices and politics: What Brazil's favorite steak says about the election
wire.summary: President Lula promised Brazilians four years ago they'd be able to afford picanha again. Now, as he seeks another term, the price of the country's favorite cut of beef is telling a different story.

wire.title: En esta ciudad de Pensilvania, los dos partidos políticos buscan el voto latino
wire.summary: Los republicanos lograron avances con los latinos en el último ciclo electoral, pero la economía y la frustración por la política migratoria de Donald Trump han corroído ese apoyo.

wire.title: COMIC: How the census gives your state power (and what Trump wants to change)
wire.summary: The census is used to determine how much say your state has in Congress and the Electoral College. President Trump failed to alter it during his first term, but he's trying again ahead of 2030.

wire.title: Trade tensions mean fewer Canadians flocking to South Florida
wire.summary: This South Florida community is typically a refuge for Canadians fleeing cold weather, but trade tensions between the United States and Canada mean fewer are coming.

wire.title: Tennessee halts executions after Christa Pike survives two lethal injection attempts
wire.summary: Pike had been on death row since she was convicted in 1996 for the murder of Colleen Slemmer.

wire.title: What happened in the failed execution of Christa Pike - and what next?
wire.summary: The convicted killer is in hospital in Tennessee after surviving two lethal injections, in a case that has raised many questions.

wire.title: Netanyahu says Flydubai attacker had 'Islamist radical indoctrination'
wire.summary: Israel's prime minister says the pilot who tried to take over the Flydubai plane clearly intended to "down the plane".

wire.title: Putin warns West that Russia is ready to use every weapon to protect Kaliningrad
wire.summary: Vladimir Putin insists Moscow is "not threatening anyone" and merely responding to statements by Western leaders.

wire.title: Trump's AI rebrand causes 'unprecedented' demand for Slovenian website names
wire.summary: The president wants AI to be called super intelligence - or SI - the same initials used by Slovenian domains.

wire.title: Russian dissident Garry Kasparov says US warned him of danger to his life
wire.summary: "My family and I will not truly be safe as long as Putin is in power," says the former chess world champion.
